newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI to release rupee convertibility report.
newsitem.headline: India RBI to release rupee convertibility report.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said it will release on Tuesday a report of a committee it had set up to advise the central bank on capital convertibility of the Indian rupee.
"S. S. Tarapore, chairman of the committee on capital convertibilty, will formally present the report of the committee to the RBI governor at 12.00 noon (0630 GMT) on Tuesday," the RBI said.
The committee was set up on the advise of the government to prepare a roadmap for achieving full convertibility, officials said.
